services.name: fly fishing
services.desc: All Water Adventures can accommodate small to large groups, we also have several boats available for even larger parties. Although we can’t promise you will catch a trophy shark, we can promise we will give it every effort and make sure to have a good time! The waters a couple miles out of Cape Canaveral can be good for a wide array of sharks and giant rays. Our most popular trips are evening/night shark trips where we fish from 3-5 hours, soaking our shark baits in the shadow of the Space Center. Commonly caught shark species include lemon, finetooth, black nose, nurse, blacktip, spinner, hammerhead, sandbar and a vast array of other hard-pulling sharks, not to mention some huge rays. We

services.name: Airboat Tours
services.desc: Central Florida Airboat Tours is the premier Space Coast airboat tour that explores the beauty and nature of the St. Johns River. Perfect for families and small groups. Along this ride, you can expect to see many different creatures including alligators, turtles, frogs, countless species of birds, fish, plants, and maybe even Bigfoot! The serene environment will relax you as you take in all that nature here has to offer, and at the same time having the thrill of riding Winding trails, shallow waters, and swamplands on the airboat that will keep you wanting to see more and more. blurb: All Water Adventures offers private charters and shore excursions such as Near Shore Fishing, Deep Sea Fishing, and Airboat Tours around Port Canaveral, Indian River Lagoon System, and the St. Johns River. Trips target a variety of sport fish and include options for small to large groups. They also offer interactive eco tours with wildlife viewing and a learning touch tank.
